### Demonstration of ps SE improvement

```{r}
set.seed(222)
R <- 100
sim <- t(sapply(1:R, 
              function(i) {
  ss <- apipopc |> 
    select.2sc(n=100, cfraction=0.30, mmin=2, clustervar="dnum") 
  d1 <- svydesign(ids=~dnum+snum, fpc=~bigN1+bigN2, data=ss)  
  d2 <- postStratify(d1, strata=~stype, population=stype.benchmarks)
  e1 <- ff(svymean(~api00, design=d1))
  e2 <- ff(svymean(~api00, design=d2))
  return(c(e1,e2))
}))
```


```{r}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(sim[,1],main="Simple estimates",xlim=c(0.9,1.1)*range(sim[,c(1,3)]))
abline(v=mean(apipopc$api00),col="red",lwd=2)
hist(sim[,3],main="Postratified estimates",xlim=c(0.9,1.1)*range(sim[,c(1,3)]))
abline(v=mean(apipopc$api00),col="red",lwd=2)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
hist(sim[,2],main="SE of Simple estimates",xlim=c(0.8,1.2)*range(sim[,c(2,4)]))
abline(v=sd(sim[,1]),col="red",lwd=2)
hist(sim[,4],main="SE of Postratified estimates",xlim=c(0.8,1.2)*range(sim[,c(2,4)]))
abline(v=sd(sim[,3]),col="red",lwd=2)

```
